issues.issue: The page prints only 'Taxes' in the Inheritance Tax Fund column. Calling it inheritance tax is a reasonable assumption from the fund name, and the line is marked review. The same applies to detail[34].

The whole budget of the 'Other' line was assigned to the charges-for-services piece of the split. The report does not split the budget. The same thing was done for detail[38] (Road/Bridge Sinking Public Works, budget 5,713,340 of the whole DISBURSEMENTS line) and detail[56] (Economic Development, budget 122,960 of the whole Receipts line). Budget-versus-actual comparisons on these pieces will be misleading.
